text:
Maya: heads-up — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/8421 needs 2x LGTM before cutoff at 2026-06-15 23:00 PDT (06:00 UTC). It’s a hotfix for kv-cache eviction that’s blocking the canary.
Ethan: looking now, running local smoke. If CI green i can give one LGTM.
Li: i’m in europe, will be asleep for cutoff window. can i be a delegated approver for night-owl? happy to sign off earlier if tests pass.
Maya: thanks Li — that’d help. final deploy window is tight, need both approvals by cutoff or we move to fallback plan.
Shreya: on PTO today with limited signal, but leaving a quick note — if CI passes and there are no infra changes, i delegate approvals to @Li for this PR (see CODEOWNERS: infra/*). :white_check_mark:
Ethan: CI currently failing on `ci/test-inference` — looks like a flaky integration: `TimeoutError: socket hang up` in kv-cache smoke. rerunning job 3/3.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] scheduled cutoff window at 2026-06-16T06:00:00Z — auto-rollforward disabled during cutoff.
Maya: to be clear — if tests pass and Li + Ethan LGTM, we’ll merge and start canary. if only one approver by cutoff, we hold and ship next-day.
Li: rerun passed. logs look clean now. i pushed one tiny doc tweak (non-functional). giving LGTM now. :thumbsup:
Ethan: gave LGTM too. tested locally with kv-cache warmup, looks good.
Maya: great — i’m going to merge once GH CI status shows all green and i’ll trigger canary. thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
Ethan: note — revert plan ready: branch hotfix/8421-revert and script `scripts/rollback_canary.sh` updated.
Shreya: noted, thanks for keeping rollback rehearsal updated. enjoy the canary!
Maya: merged at 1768382500. deploying canary now. will post status.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] canary started for release hotfix-8421 at 2026-06-16T06:01:10Z — health checks passing (3/3).
Maya: canary healthy after 10m. promoting to 10% traffic now. anyone else want to double-check logs for anomalies?
Ethan: scanning logs — nothing unusual in the last 15m.
Li: all good from my side.
Maya: promoting to full after 30m if no regressions. closing thread, thanks team :tada:
